title: Weekly Puzzle #37 – New Super Marionette Bros U
selftext:
Please put proposed solutions behind spoiler markup (> and ! at start, then ! and < at end).

I am swamped with work so this puzzle is a few days late, and the excellent folks at the [Unofficial Discord's puzzle channel](https://discord.com/channels/569683781800296501/854891541969109033) have not had their usual chance to playtest – hopefully everything still works!

[An archive of previous weekly puzzles can be found here.](https://notquitetangible.blogspot.com/2024/11/clocktower-puzzle-archive.html)
